<<prodname>> allows you to build and manage each of your customer interactions/journeys in dedicated named workspaces referred to as 'services'. You can create a new service by clicking the **Create New Service** button on the top-right corner of the <<prodname>> home page.

Once clicked, provide a name for your service and click CREATE.

{
  "images": [
    {

This takes you to the Service Dashboard of the newly created service where you can buy numbers for SMS and voice interactions, configure app assets for Push, In-App messaging, <<AMB>>, Messenger, WhatsApp, and other messaging channels, access service key or JWT token i.e. needed for using the Messaging and Event APIs, and build rules and flows for automating customer interactions.
